name: sandeep-mods
description: Sandeep Mods: Claude Code mods collected, standardized and maintained by Sandeep

plugins.name: agent-compact-advisor
plugins.description: Shows a 0-100 status line score for how good a moment it is to /compact, and adds a preservation template to every compaction.

plugins.name: aside
plugins.description: Opens a read-only side chat pane where you ask about the session so far; a tool-less fork of the transcript answers and nothing enters the main thread.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky Bash commands and shows what they would change before they run.

plugins.name: cctop
plugins.description: Shows a live dashboard of your session's cost, tokens, context and tools in a pane, and lets Claude answer questions from the same numbers.

plugins.name: context-view
plugins.description: Shows how full the context window is as a meter row above the prompt, with the percentage used and the tokens left before auto-compact.

plugins.name: cost-guard
plugins.description: Shows what each chat, reply and day costs, warns you when a chat gets long, and converts documents to markdown before Claude reads them.

plugins.name: deploy-verify
plugins.description: After a deploy command succeeds, checks the live URL with cache-busting and tells Claude the result, so a deploy is not called done without evidence.

plugins.name: flightdeck
plugins.description: Shows a live dashboard of context, cost, permission checks and subagents in a Claude Code pane, built from real session events.

plugins.name: github-issues
plugins.description: Lists a repository's GitHub issues in a side pane, with one click to have Claude work on one.

plugins.name: harness-scope
plugins.description: Turns global skills, rules, agents and tools on or off per repo using named profiles.

plugins.name: launch-codes
plugins.description: Asks for a one-time code and a second confirmation before Claude runs a dangerous Bash command such as rm -rf, git push --force or vercel --prod.

plugins.name: md-preview
plugins.description: Shows the Markdown files Claude edits, rendered like GitHub, in a pane next to the chat, with before and after side by side.

plugins.name: micro-compaction
plugins.description: Adds /compact micro, which replaces Read results with short placeholders and drops thinking without calling a model.

plugins.name: pr-pulse
plugins.description: Watch your GitHub pull requests from Claude Code: checks, merge readiness, comments, review queue and change alerts.

plugins.name: prismantis
plugins.description: Redraws Claude Code replies with themeable colors: tables, headings, code, diagrams, tool rows and copy buttons.

plugins.name: rabe
plugins.description: Shows the subagents, Codex jobs, shells, monitors, cron jobs and workflows running in the background, in a band above the prompt and a pane.

plugins.name: receipt
plugins.description: Shows what each turn did in a band above the prompt: files changed, commands, failures, reads and subagents.

plugins.name: secret-redactor
plugins.description: Replaces secrets, email addresses and public IP addresses in the chat with stable placeholders, and restores the real values when a tool runs.

plugins.name: terminal-browser
plugins.description: Opens a real browser in a pane inside Claude Code, with a /browser command and an optional tool that lets the agent open pages.

plugins.name: todo-bar
plugins.description: Shows the task list's progress in a band above the prompt, read from Claude's own todo and task tool calls.

plugins.name: weektoken
plugins.description: Shows your 5-hour, weekly and per-model usage limits against elapsed time, with a forecast and history, in a band above the prompt and a pane.
